title: Query and Path Parameters with Validation
learning_objectives: Declare optional and required query parameters with defaults
Add constraints with Annotated, Query and Path
Restrict a parameter to fixed choices with an Enum
Accept repeated query parameters as a list
hints: `class Order(str, Enum): asc = "asc"; desc = "desc"` and the parameter `order: Order = Order.asc`.
`limit: Annotated[int, Query(ge=1, le=5)] = 3`; `year: Annotated[int, Path(ge=1900, le=2100)]`.
`sorted(matches, key=lambda b: (b["year"], b["id"]), reverse=order == Order.desc)`; tags: `tag: Annotated[list[str], Query()] = []` and `set(tag) <= set(b["tags"])`.

failure_feedback.advice: Sort by (year, id) ascending by default and return 3 items.
Filter case-insensitively, reverse the sort for desc, then slice `[offset:offset + limit]`.
Declare the constraints with `Annotated[..., Query(...)]` and use an Enum for order.
Use `Annotated[int, Path(ge=1900, le=2100)]` for the year.
Declare `tag: Annotated[list[str], Query()] = []` and keep books whose tags include all of them.
Constraints declared with Query appear in the OpenAPI schema.
